title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blueberry Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blueberry Raspberry brings together the deep, juicy sweetness of Blueberry with the bright, tangy notes of Raspberry for a bold and refreshing fruit vape. The smooth balance of rich and tart flavours makes this an ideal all-day vape for fruit lovers. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers rapid nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-defined flavour while maintaining discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
